audience: small agencies and service firms that run CRM, invoices and projects in Agiled

useCases.title: Review open deals and accounts
useCases.text: List the CRM deals by name or status, then read one deal and its account.

useCases.title: Find a contact by email
useCases.text: List the contacts filtered by email or name, then read one contact by id.

useCases.title: Check invoices and payments
useCases.text: List invoices by status, read one invoice, and list the payments recorded against invoices.

useCases.title: Track project tasks and time
useCases.text: List projects and their tasks, and the time entries tracked on them.

useCases.title: Add a contact without duplicates
useCases.text: Search the contacts by email first, then create the contact with an idempotency key so a retry does not duplicate it.
